item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las yi dam gu ru drag po'i rgyud las sbyin sreg khro chu dbal mda'
item.coloph: bka' gsang ba gu ru thugs bcud drag po'i sbyin sreg las kyi go rim khro chu'i dbal dang 'dra ba phyi rabs don du/ mkha' spyod pa sngags kyi 'khor lo 'chang ba'i gar dbang byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyis sbyar ba'o//
